assessments.approximation: RHF/STO-3G is acceptable only as a neutral-singlet H2 fixed-point instrument over 0.60–1.20 angstrom. Three-node quadratic matrix interpolation and exact Coulomb nuclear repulsion pass the committed node and midpoint ceilings; they do not authorize geometry optimization, dissociation, correlation, DFT, or arbitrary molecules.
assessments.promotionAndRefusal: Release-only promotion after two consecutive density and energy gates is bounded and fail-closed. Outside-envelope, unverified-reference, numerical-failure, and iteration-exhaustion dispositions retain last-good and cannot promote a provisional field.
assessments.perceptualMapping: AO density coefficients, fixed-point residual, disposition, and last-good identity drive a non-metric light, tone, and haptic projection. The renderer does not solve, gate, or promote state; the mapping is not electron motion, physical relaxation time, or a quantitative density plot.
assessments.crossPlatform: TypeScript and Swift own separate deterministic authorities with one 20 Hz logical cadence and semantic trace comparison; WebGL and Metal consume compact immutable projections scoped to the stable H2 body.

resolvedFindings: The native field now remains drawable from last-good after release, promotion, and refusal instead of being gated by contact activity.
The verification contract now names the implemented fail-closed cassette verifier and the separate pinned PySCF regeneration command.
This versioned record supplies the previously missing review provenance and immutable artifact ledger.
limitations: This is an internal model audit, not external peer review.
The audit environment did not independently install and rerun PySCF; it reviewed the committed generator, 25 node references, 24 midpoint references, measured errors, and fail-closed verifier.
Simulator evidence can establish deterministic authority, Metal wiring, and accessibility semantics, but not physical Taptic timing, sensor behavior, energy, thermal, or device GPU performance.
The perceptual field is deliberately qualitative and must not be read as an orbital isosurface or measured electron density.
approvalBoundary: Only approved-for-bounded-instrument permits release; it approves this declared H2 envelope and no broader scientific claim.
